jobs.description:
As a Technical Support Advisor, you are the point of contact for BEA's business customers throughout Europe, with a particular history in the German-speaking area. 

Your missions:
 
Customer & internal technical support
  
• Answer customers' technical questions by phone, WhatsApp or e-mail, with a particular focus on VIP customers and high-value sensors. 
• Diagnose faults remotely and propose concrete solutions 
• Support our customers' technicians in the installation, wiring and configuration of BEA sensors. 
• Manage incoming calls from the technical hotline for Europe and provide product support to the European sales team. 
• Provide ongoing internal support in conjunction with other members of the technical team. 
• Participate in the creation, optimization and coordination of technical documentation (e.g. wiring diagrams, instructions) for customers in the field.  
Continuous improvement & documentation
  
• Collect and transmit relevant field feedback to the sales, product and R&D teams, in a logic of continuous improvement. 
• Write reports and feed the internal knowledge base, to promote the sharing of expertise within the company (sales, marketing, product). 
• Define and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) related to the quality of service and products, using a ticketing system, to measure customer satisfaction and identify areas for improvement. 
• Participate in product tests (BEA sensors and competitors) in collaboration with Product Management and R&D teams. 
• Organize the planning of customer visits by the technical team.  
Team
 
You will join the sales department, within the Pedestrian Door Detectors (PES) segment.
 
Your direct technical referent, Sandra, currently holds this position, which she knows like the back of her hand. She will still be active in customer technical support, with a stronger focus on internal training, while actively supporting you during your integration. Trilingual, rigorous, challenging and always available, she ensures that customers receive impeccable service.

Your experience and education: 
 
• Minimum 2 years of experience in a support function 
• Strong interest in electronic, electromechanical or connected solutions 
• Good command of office tools and ability to read technical guides 
• Excellent command of German, French and English (spoken and written)  
Your soft skills and personal qualities:
  
• Excellent interpersonal skills, ability to ask the right questions and reassure customers 
• Curiosity, thirst for learning and spirit of investigation 
• Method, rigor and stress management 
• Taste for teamwork and openness to feedback 
• Ability to interact with different internal contact (PM, sales, R&D, quality)

jobs.occupation: Senior Accountant in Brussels - International company

jobs.description:
Our client plays a key role in establishing the future of renewable energy in Belgium and Europe. Join a vibrant and an international environment with a great work-life balance.

Jobomschrijving

 In this role you will report to the head of finance and will be carrying out the following tasks:

• Lead the accounting function and ensure compliant financial reporting.
• Own the month-end and year-end close process.
• Manage, coach, and develop the accounting team (2 direct reports).
• Ensure accuracy and integrity of the General Ledger.
• Lead external audits and coordinate with auditors.
• Oversee Belgian and European VAT compliance.
• Advise on accounting policies and complex transactions.
• Review reconciliations, accruals, provisions, and key journal entries.
• Improve processes, controls, and accounting procedures.
• Drive finance systems, automation, and AI initiatives.

The ideal candidate matches the following criteria:

• Bachelor's degree in accounting or equivalent 
• Minimum 7 years of experience in accounting 
• Fluent in French or Dutch and English
• Strong experience in VAT compliance and tax declarations.
• Experience with multi-country VAT registrations and compliance is a strong asset.
• Experience with Dynamics 365 is a plus
• Strong communication skills

jobs.occupation: Sales & Marketing Manager - Agricultural Machinery - FR/DU
jobs.description:
Our client is a Belgian family-owned company with over 100 years of experience in the distribution of premium technical equipment for the agricultural sector, the green/landscaping sector, and material handling. It employees +100person, generates +150M€ of annual turnover and aims to strengthen its market position by focusing on leading-edge technology, strong partnerships with dealers, and efficient services in sales, marketing, after-sales, and financing.

Jobomschrijving

As a successful Sales & Marketing Manager - Agricultural Machinery - FR/DU, you will have the following responsibilities:

• Lead the commercial strategy: annual sales plan, margins, product mix

• Animate and guide the sales & marketing team (define priorities, coordinate & coach the team on the field) - you will be responsible of 3 areas sales manager, 3 product managers & 2 persons in the back office 

• Manage pricing strategy and negotiate with key accounts & dealer networks

• Develop business via demo machines, rental, and used equipment

• Be responsible of the company brand by owning all marketing & communication activities & ensuring their consistency: marketing materials, digital channels, campaigns, ... 
• Handle the implementation of a new CRM system
• Strengthen communication with the dealer network: newsletters, events, information sessions

• Oversee events & trade fairs: stand concept, logistics, demos, post-event analysis

• Act as main link between manufacturer & internal teams; track KPIs, market trends, bonuses

As a successful Sales & Marketing Manager - Agricultural Machinery - FR/DU, you will have the following profile:

• +5 years experiences as B2B sales leader with strong commercial development skills & ability to negotiate with wholesalers 
• Experiences with long selling cycle & technical products (agriculture, machinery, industry)
• Previous experience in people management or team coaching 
• Background or strong affinity with the agriculture sector is a plus 
• Solid experience in operational marketing 
• Comfortable in managing projects (CRM, reporting, process optimization)
• Strategical mindset coupled with the willingness to remain operational & available for the teams 
• Personal traits: entrepreneurial mindset, structured, responsible, clear communicator, low ego. 
• Languages: Fluent in French, Dutch & English

The hiring organization is a respected entity focused on consumer advocacy and policy development. As a medium-sized organization, it is committed to addressing consumer needs through research, policy work, and collaboration with stakeholders.

Jobomschrijving

As a Policy Officer your responsibilities are:

• Analyze and assess consumer policies with a focus on economic perspectives.
• Develop and implement strategies for effective advocacy at the European and international levels.
• Collaborate with internal teams and external stakeholders to advance consumer interests.
• Monitor policy developments and identify opportunities to influence decision-making processes.
• Prepare reports, briefings, and presentations to support policy positions.
• Represent the organization in meetings, events, and consultations with policymakers and other stakeholders.
• Provide expertise on economic aspects of consumer protection and market practices.
• Contribute to the overall objectives of the Marketing & Agency department.

A successful Policy Officer should have:

• A Master's degree in Economics or Business Studies.
• Strong experience in European or international policy and advocacy.
• Proficiency in assessing consumer policy areas, particularly from an economic perspective.
• Excellent communication and analytical skills.
• Ability to collaborate effectively with diverse stakeholders.
• A proactive and results-oriented approach to work.
• Excellent level of English both written and verbal, French and Dutch is a plus.

jobs.occupation: Animal Health Sales Director - Veterinary - Pharma
jobs.description:
Our client is a Belgian company specialising in the development, registration, marketing and commercialisation of veterinary pharmaceutical products for both livestock and companion animal. The organisation has built a strong reputation through its scientific expertise, in-house R&D laboratory, and regulatory excellence. Operating internationally through a network of manufacturing and distribution partners, the company offers innovative veterinary solutions across multiple continents while maintaining the agility, ownership culture, and entrepreneurial spirit of a growing SME.

Jobomschrijving

As a successful Animal Health Sales Manager - Pharmaceutical Products - Veterinary channel, you will have the following responsibilities: 

Business Development - Creation of new partnerships

• Identify new business opportunities and evaluate new potential products for the portfolio.
• Conduct market analysis to identify unmet needs within the Belgian veterinary sector.
• Assess partnerships with pharmaceutical manufacturers and negotiate exclusive distribution opportunities.
• Define product positioning, pricing strategies, and go-to-market plans.
• Prepare and support product launches in collaboration with the sales team.

Field Sales Management 

• Develop and execute the commercial strategy for the Belgian market.
• Lead, motivate, and coach a team of 5 sales representatives covering Belgium.
• Maintain close contact with key stakeholders in the Belgian veterinary market.
• Monitor market trends, competition, and business performance.

As a successful Animal Health Sales Manager - Pharmaceutical Products - Veterinary channel, you will have the following profile:

• Veterinary degree or equivalent in-depth expertise and network within the veterinary industry.
• 10/15 years of experiences in the Animal Health industry.
• Strong knowledge of the Belgian veterinary market and its key stakeholders.
• Proven experience in a commercial, sales management, or business development role.
• Previous experience managing and coaching sales teams.
• Strategic mindset combined with a hands-on approach.
• Strong interpersonal and stakeholder management skills.
• Fluent in Dutch with a good level of English.

FMCG

Jobomschrijving

• Create and maintain production plans
• Ensure products are available for customer orders and stock
• Monitor production constraints daily and adjust schedules when needed
• Support projects related to new product launches, phase-outs, and process improvements
• Work with different teams to coordinate product launches and discontinuations
• Represent the planning team in internal meetings
• Keep planning data and systems up to date
• Communicate with planning, production, purchasing, and customer service teams to solve planning challenges

• Great communication skills in Dutch, English and French
• Related bachelor or master 
• Stress resistant and assertive
• Experience in Production Planning 
• Experience within FMCG is a big plus
• Good SAP knowledge

Our client is a European transport company specialising in the hire of plastic pallets.

Jobomschrijving

Do you enjoy problem-solving, adapting to new situations and communicating with people from different countries? Then we have a great challenge for you!

We are looking for a motivated Customer Service Assistant for an innovative transport company in Schelle (Antwerp) who can communicate fluently in English, Polish and German.

You’ll be a key link within the logistics department. Working with various partners and sites, you’ll ensure that return shipments are collected smoothly, efficiently and on time. No two days are the same: you’ll plan, coordinate, follow up and step in when things don’t go to plan.

Your mission?

To ensure that every collection runs as smoothly as possible. You’ll maintain an overview, liaise with the relevant parties and spot potential issues before they become real problems.

In practical terms, this means that you:

• Plan and organise collections by creating weekly schedules and maintaining contact with the relevant partners and locations.

• Actively track which locations have not yet been contacted and ensure that no collection slips through the net.

• Monitor performance and help devise solutions when a collection does not go to plan.

• Keep customer details up to date, from telephone numbers and email addresses to opening hours and other practical information.

• Continuously look for smart ways to increase the success rate of collections.

Can you tick off the following points? Then you’re the Customer Service we’re looking for!
	
• • You’re multilingual. You communicate fluently in English, Polish and German and feel at ease in an international working environment.	
• Transport and logistics appeal to you. Experience is a bonus, but not essential. Your motivation, eagerness to learn and interest in the sector are just as important.	
• You’re curious and keen to learn. You pick up new information quickly and have an interest in transport and logistics.	
• You like structure. You work in an organised manner and ensure your records are kept clearly, transparently and efficiently.	
• You take the initiative. You don’t always wait for someone to tell you what needs doing, but contribute your own ideas and aren’t afraid to take action.	
• You’re confident and self-assured. Even when things don’t go to plan, you stay calm, focus on solutions and aren’t afraid to make decisions.	
• You’re a real team player. You enjoy working with others, help colleagues where needed and bring a positive vibe to the team with your energy.	
• You have your own transport and can get to Schelle with ease.

Are you ready to take the next step in your career as a Technical Operator? As a vital member of our team, you'll work with cutting-edge machinery to produce high-quality steel profiles. You'll become an expert in operating our state-of-the-art equipment, ensuring that production runs smoothly and efficiently.

Every day, you'll engage with complex and simple finishing machines including conventional and CNC-controlled systems like sawing machines, drilling machines, and laser cutters. Your keen attention to detail and commitment to quality will ensure that every component meets our high standards.

We're looking for motivated and eager-to-learn individuals. Apply now to join a supportive environment where your skills will be valued and developed!

• Technical school diploma or equivalent experience

• Proficiency in reading and executing mechanical diagrams

• Fluency in English

• Knowledge of pneumatics and ability to install tubes and test movements

• Passion for technology and a team-oriented mindset

• Eagerness to learn with a conscientious and responsible approach

• Strict adherence to safety rules and flexibility in working hours
